# LabRF fixtures (synthetic)

| File | Format | Contents |
|------|--------|----------|
| `mock_iq.npz` | NumPy `.npz` | Complex IQ + `meta_sample_rate` / `meta_center_freq` (and tone notes) |

**Synthetic only** — generated by `labrf.iq.generate_synthetic_iq` / `ensure_default_fixture`.
Not a live RTL-SDR capture. Used for CI and the mock UI path (`Load mock fixture`).

Load with `labrf.iq.load_iq_fixture`.
